description: KitchenGrade searches captured Florida DBPR records for Lake, Orange, Osceola and Seminole counties only. This is not statewide coverage or a live statewide search. Get the current KitchenGrade grade and dated inspection basis for an exact public DBPR establishment ID (e.g. 2010:5816523) in this catalog. A missing ID is not evidence of closure or no inspections. Preserves unavailable/historical/expired grades as unknown, without guessing. KitchenGrade independent grade is not issued by DBPR and is not a food-safety guarantee.

establishment_id.description: Exact public KitchenGrade DBPR establishment ID (not name or a private identifier).
